findings.location: Synthetic discovery brief: Outcome O1 and Actors
findings.evidence: The artifact asserts 'support manager measures weekly' and includes the support manager as an actor. The supplied source facts establish support agents and an instrumented queue, but do not confirm a support manager, measurement ownership or weekly cadence.
findings.criterion: Business outcome, actors, success measures and proposed assumptions must be clearly distinguished; no invented agreed facts.
findings.impact: Downstream requirements could treat an unconfirmed measurement responsibility and cadence as agreed business requirements.
findings.resolution: Label the support manager role, measurement ownership and weekly cadence as proposed, unconfirmed assumptions, or remove them. Obtain explicit source confirmation before treating them as agreed facts.

summary: Outcome, target, timeframe, scope, exclusions and design unknowns are clear. The absent wiki and synthetic fixture status are disclosed. One blocking source-fidelity finding remains; this review grants no human acceptance.
